ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across the primary surface area with localized high-intensity (white) clusters at the distal tips and sparse high-intensity punctate noise across the lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous clusters located at the extreme left and right distal tips. A sparse constellation of individual high-intensity pixels is distributed across the lower quadrant of the right lobe and the mid-region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 105 degrees; depth is roughly 1/6th of the vertical axis of the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrated boundary along the entire trailing edge; multiple micro-peaks and valleys ranging from 2 to 8 pixels in amplitude, particularly pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge from the median notch extending towards the distal tips, terminating in a convex sweep at the outer-most lateral points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast circular pixel clusters detected at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; secondary sparse circular white marks (1-4 pixels in diameter) visible in the lower-central region of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One distinct curvilinear high-intensity line located in the lower-mid quadrant of the left lobe, approximately 20 pixels in length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, high-contrast textured material/growth at the lateral-most tips of both flukes, exhibiting high-frequency pixel variation compared to the smooth low-intensity surface of the main lobes.
